script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Continental Milkose India Ltd. se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — aapka account kaafi purana hai, lagbhag 27 saal se, aur pehle activity bhi achhi thi, lekin last 30 days mein aapka platform par ek bhi login nahi hua aur 3 buyer inquiries ka koi reply nahi gaya — yeh dekh ke hum concerned hue, isliye directly call kiya.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, seedha poochhna chahta hoon — kuch mahine pehle tak aap platform use kar rahe the, phir achanak activity bilkul band ho gayi; kya koi specific problem aayi IndiaMART ke saath, ya business mein koi aur cheez chal rahi hai jis wajah se yeh sab peeche reh gaya?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important baat share karna chahta hoon — aapke 3 unanswered buyer leads hain jo abhi bhi pending hain, aur demand tier Red hai matlab is category mein buyers hain lekin competition bhi hai; agar yeh leads ab bhi respond karne layak hain toh aaj hum milke unhe open karein, warna yeh window close ho jaati hai.
script_parts.action: Abhi is call par, main aapko account mein login karwata hoon — sirf 2 minute lagenge — aur hum saath milke un 3 pending buyer leads ko dekhenge aur ek quick reply draft karenge, bas yeh ek kaam aaj ho jaaye.
script_parts.close: Aapko koi bada commitment nahi chahiye abhi — bas yeh ek login aur ek reply aaj ho jaaye, aur phir hum ek short follow-up call schedule kar lete hain 3-4 din mein dekhne ke liye ki kuch traction aayi ya nahi — yeh theek rahega aapke liye?

script_parts_en.opening: Good day, am I speaking with someone from Continental Milkose India Ltd.? I'm calling from IndiaMART — your account is nearly 27 years old and was previously active, but in the last 30 days there have been zero logins and 3 buyer inquiries have gone completely unanswered, which flagged an alert on our end and prompted this call.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to ask you directly — there was a clear drop in platform activity around 4 months ago, almost a 64% cliff in engagement; was there a specific issue with IndiaMART, or has something shifted on the business side that pushed the platform to the backburner?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's a concrete data point worth noting — you have 3 buyer leads sitting unanswered right now, and your demand tier is Red, meaning buyers are actively searching in your category but competition is present; every day these go unreplied, the probability of converting them drops significantly.
script_parts_en.action: Right now on this call, I'd like to walk you through logging back in — it takes under 2 minutes — and together we'll pull up those 3 pending buyer leads and draft at least one reply so the account shows activity today.
script_parts_en.close: No big commitment needed from your side right now — just this one login and one reply today, and then let's schedule a quick 10-minute follow-up call in 3 to 4 days to check if any of those leads responded; does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
